title: Hearth Zigbee2MQTT entity mapping profile, version 1
description: Authoritative contract for embedded Zigbee2MQTT planner profiles and profile overrides. This schema enforces every schema-expressible requirement: closed objects, version 1, the planner/override discriminated union, bounded identifiers and strings, known device kinds and planner roles, the closed entity source oneOf, all twelve strategy parameter shapes, and override selector and patch shapes. Cross-field and cross-document rules (minimum below maximum, reference targets and ordering, strategy and source compatibility, override overlap and target-kind matching, aggregate catalog limits) are semantic compiler checks owned by the catalog loader, not this schema.

$schema.description: Optional schema pointer carried by embedded documents. It is metadata only and never affects planning precedence.

version.description: Profile contract version. Only version 1 documents are accepted.

kind.description: Discriminates planner profiles from profile overrides.

id.description: Document identifier. Planner profile IDs are referenced by diagnostics; override IDs must be unique but carry no planning meaning.

order.description: Explicit planner precedence. Profiles evaluate in ascending order; uniqueness is a semantic compiler check.

candidate_groups.description: Candidate groups in evaluation order. At most 64 groups per profile; 512 total rules per catalog is a semantic compiler check.

device_entities.description: Device-level entities evaluated once after candidate groups. May be absent or empty.

patches.description: Rule patches in document order. At most 64 patches per override.

ruleId.description: Profile, group, and rule identifier: lowercase alphanumeric segments joined by single dots or hyphens, at most 64 characters. Applies to document IDs, candidate group IDs, rule IDs, and every rule or group reference.

entityKey.description: Unscoped stable entity base key. Profiles cannot construct endpoint suffixes or external IDs; Go applies scoped identity.

exposeType.description: Exact upstream expose type matched against retained inventory.

exposeName.description: Exact upstream expose name matched against retained inventory.

unitString.description: Unit string of at most 32 characters. An empty string in accepted_units means the upstream unit must be absent; no implicit conversion occurs.

device_kind.description: Device kind this planner contribution establishes.

role.description: The first non-empty primary contribution wins; every supplemental contribution appends in order.

cardinality.description: Requires exactly one matching root across the Device. Omission evaluates every retained matching root in inventory order.

candidateRootSelector.description: Selects candidate roots by exact expose type and optional exact name, with optional exact-one cardinality.

exposeSelector.description: Selects one device-level upstream root by exact expose type and optional exact name through UniqueRoot.

oneOf.title: root source
oneOf.description: Passes the selected root expose to the strategy. Permits only kind.

oneOf.title: feature source
oneOf.description: Performs the exact-one UniqueFeature(type, name) lookup inside the selected root.

oneOf.title: derived source
oneOf.description: Version 1 accepts only color-mode. It passes no expose to the strategy; the strategy receives the root, the expose index, and declared prior plans.

source.description: Closed entity source union. The selected form forbids fields not shown for that form.

emptyParams.description: Exact empty parameter object for strategies with no profile-controlled parameters.

accepted_units.description: One to four unique exact upstream units. An empty string requires the upstream unit to be absent.

number_format.description: integer uses exact-integer decoding; float accepts finite JSON numbers and preserves fractions.

bounds.description: Discriminated bound union. fixed always uses the configured bounds; upstream-or-fallback prefers both present valid finite upstream bounds and uses the configured values only when both are genuinely absent. minimum below maximum is a semantic compiler check.

accepted_units.description: One to four unique exact upstream units. Include an empty string when an absent upstream unit is required.

unit.description: Optional Hearth support unit. When omitted, support omits its optional unit.

access.description: set-only requires access to equal the set bit; includes-set requires the set bit and ignores additional bits.

name.description: Closed strategy name. Unknown names are rejected.

parameters.description: Strategy parameters. Each strategy accepts only its documented parameter object.

strategy.description: Closed strategy reference. The name discriminates which parameter object is accepted.

gate_rule.description: When present, that rule must be the first entity rule; optional siblings evaluate only when the gate produces a valid plan. Gate existence, position, and duplicate-gate-key removal are semantic compiler and evaluator checks.

entities.description: Entity rules in evaluation order. At most 64 rules per group.

requires_any.description: Sibling dependency. Referenced rules must be earlier rules in the same candidate group; the reference target and ordering are semantic compiler checks.

requires_group_survivor.description: Names a candidate group that must retain at least one candidate after gate planning. The target must exist and carry a gate rule; both are semantic compiler checks.

vendor.description: Required exact vendor string. Never enters binding or entity identities.

model.description: Required exact model string. Never enters binding or entity identities.

software_build_ids.description: Optional non-empty unique list of exact firmware strings. Firmware is never interpreted as semantic versions.

rule.description: Target rule. The target must exist; whether the rule is a candidate or device rule is a semantic compiler check.

enabled.description: Defaults to true in the base layer. An exact-build patch may explicitly re-enable a rule disabled by the general patch.

source.description: Complete replacement candidate source. Valid only for candidate-entity targets; target-kind matching is a semantic compiler check.

expose.description: Complete replacement device expose match. Valid only for device-entity targets; target-kind matching is a semantic compiler check.

strategy_parameters.description: Complete replacement strategy parameters. The value must be a valid parameter object for some strategy; matching the target rule strategy is a semantic compiler check.

rulePatch.description: Patch fields overlay independently and each present object field replaces that complete field. Source and expose are mutually exclusive; matching either field to the target rule kind is a semantic compiler check.
